related.description: An integration that allows Claude Desktop to interact with Spotify using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Control Spotify from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. 100+ tools for playback, playlists, discovery, and curation.
MCP server for bulk Spotify operations - batch playlist creation with confidence scoring, library exports, CSV imports, and human-in-the-loo...
A ruby wrapper for the Spotify Web API
